:::{#exm-second-derivative-test}
#### Second derivative test for powers of $x$

The [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f(x) = x^2$ has the [flat point](#def-flat-point) $c = 0$ and [second derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-second-derivative) $f''(0) = 2 > 0$,
so $0$ is a [local minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-local-minimizer) by @thm-second-derivative-test.

:::
